original.statement: Helm option `enableCiliumEndpointSlice` is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; use `ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled` instead.

decision.reason: [ev-79276bab0c0a] says the Helm option `enableCiliumEndpointSlice` has been deprecated, will be removed in a future release, and has been replaced by `ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled`. That supports change type "deprecated" with replacedBy helm-value path ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled. The values validator confirms that enableCiliumEndpointSlice is still a values key [ev-28e0ccb5774a][ev-39a22d88e2f5], so the option still exists and is deprecated, not removed.
